items.title: MECH-322 replay-origin corroboration survival under realistic conditions
items.note: DIAGNOSTIC (excluded from confidence scoring). Follow-on to the CONFIRMED failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-873a_2026-08-07 (routed onward, NEW EXQ number, NOT a lettered 873b -- 873a's AND-gate question is answered). Question: does a replay-origin-tagged chunk, minted under valid conditions, ever get CORROBORATED by real waking execution before its dissolution deadline expires under REALISTIC (not artificially accelerated) conditions? 873a measured only the accelerated regime (N=15, checkpoint ep 90/120) and saw 7/7 dissolve. Design: 3 arms differ ONLY in the corroboration deadline N (chunk_replay_corroboration_episodes) -- ARM_DEADLINE_15 (873a accelerated replication), ARM_DEADLINE_75 (substrate DEFAULT = realistic), ARM_DEADLINE_200 (deadline beyond the 120-ep run -> deadline-independent recurrence/exposure measure); all mint identically at an EARLY checkpoint (ep 20 -> 100 post-mint waking episodes). Corroboration is emergent (FORMING replay chunk is not selectable) via trailing-match re-execution. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (corroboration/survival fraction under realistic N + early checkpoint) recorded in NO manifest -- only 873/873a flipped the flag, both accelerated-regime; not derivable from an accelerated manifest -> run. Re-derive brake: 0 MECH-322 substrate_ceiling autopsies -> not braked. DV-SYMMETRY: each arm's survival DV is a deadline-gated step function of N (not invariant under any additive/monotone/permutation symmetry); corroboration TIMING is N-independent per seed, which is what isolates the deadline. Both directions valid: a positive reading strengthens the MECH-322 lifecycle characterisation; a null reading shows the accelerated-dissolution safety valve firing as designed and does NOT weaken MECH-322. Smoke PASS (dry-run: mint fired all arms, deadline responded to N -- N=15/75 arms dissolved-by-deadline in the toy window, N>=100 arm survived). validate_experiments --strict OK.

items.title: MECH-074d BLA PE-remap attribution selectivity (wall-independent representation DV)
items.note: GOV-CONFIRM-1 confirming DV routed from IGW workset item IGW-20260807-235. MECH-074d has a BUILT substrate (SD-035 BLAAnalog, IMPLEMENTED 2026-04-21), literature_confidence 0.809 over 4 lit entries, and genuine_exp_count 0 -- its only prior tagged run, V3-EXQ-474, is a module-boundary substrate-readiness diagnostic driven by SYNTHETIC PE spikes and hand-supplied candidate dicts, never a live agent. RENUMBERED FROM V3-EXQ-893: a concurrent session landed a different v3_exq_893_mech232_da_representational_expansion_confirmer.py on origin/main at 2026-08-08T00:18Z, 13 min before this work's script commit. Safe to renumber because this entry had no coordinator DB row (see the queue-writer note below). WALL-INDEPENDENT BY CONSTRUCTION: every readout is internal to the ContextMemory store the remap writes to (per-slot displacement, off-diagonal pairwise-cosine spread, retention) plus the composition of the gate's own target sets; no behavioural outcome is read, so no wall can gate the result. No substrate_not_ready_requeue was needed at design time -- a representation DV IS designable -- but the script self-routes to that label if ARM_REMAP_ON's readiness gate comes back red. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout is per-slot ContextMemory displacement/differentiation split by remap-target status against a matched remap-disabled control. Absent from every manifest; reanalysis_query found no MECH-074d readout, and the only ContextMemory manifest in the corpus (v3_exq_477 SD-016 slot-store diagnostic, 2026-04-24) carries no BLA remap manipulation and predates the recording standard so has no substrate_hash (UNVERIFIABLE -> not recoverable) -> run. RE-DERIVE BRAKE: 0 counted substrate_ceiling autopsies on MECH-074d -> not braked. SUBSTRATE-PATH OVERLAP GATE: no open substrate_queue entry declares substrate_paths at all, so no corrupting/degrading overlap. SUBSTRATE PROBE FINDING THAT SHAPED THE DESIGN (2026-08-08): use_e2_harm_a=True is LOAD-BEARING and is NOT set by the sibling V3-EXQ-888 config -- without it _harm_a_pred_prev stays None (agent.py:8594), bla.tick gets z_harm_a_pred=None and remap_signal can NEVER fire (0 fires / 296 ticks measured). With it, 72 fires / 137 ticks. Set identically in BOTH arms. DESIGN: 2 arms x 3 seeds [42,43,45] (44 excluded per the standing reef-config early-death instability). ARM_REMAP_ON bla_remap_pe_sigma_threshold=1.0 (SD-035 default) vs ARM_REMAP_OFF 1e9 (gate can never open). Remap is held SHUT in BOTH arms through P0 so neither enters the measurement window with a pre-degraded store, and the measurement window RESTORES ContextMemory to the end-of-P0 snapshot at the start of EVERY episode in both arms -- forced by the smoke, which showed the open gate fires on ~93% of ticks and drives slot differentiation 0.0892 -> 4.9e-07 WITHIN ONE EPISODE. Without the restore, C1/C2 would measure a degeneracy the remap inflicted on itself and report it as a property of the attribution gate (verdict aliasing). A bla_remap_requires_attribution=False broadcast arm was considered and DELIBERATELY OMITTED: reading bla.py:504-531, with candidates present (and the agent always supplies them, since the softmax puts positive mass on every slot) that path is bit-identical to the default -- it would be an inert arm, not a third condition. DV-SYMMETRY (one per arm). DV group = {per-slot cm.memory content, summarised as displacement and as the spread of off-diagonal pairwise cosine similarity} + {index composition of the target sets}; these are invariant under a permutation of slots and under any transform applied identically to all slots. ARM_REMAP_ON: the manipulation is an in-place blend of a SELECTED MINORITY of slots toward a common write_signal -- neither a permutation nor a uniform-over-all-slots transform, and a blend of a strict subset toward a common vector strictly contracts pairwise distances among the written slots, so it CANNOT cancel in the spread statistic (unlike a broadcast constant, which would cancel in a range). Confirmed live: exactly 5 of 16 slots displaced per event. ARM_REMAP_OFF: the manipulation is the ABSENCE of that write; the DV registers presence-vs-absence directly (smoke: spread preserved 0.0892 with the gate shut, collapsed 4.9e-07 with it open). Neither arm's manipulation is invariant under its DV. CRITERIA (pre-registered constants; PASS iff C1 AND C2 AND C3 AND C4, each on >=2/3 seeds -- a plain AND, recorded as combination_rule). C1 [load-bearing] attribution selectivity: mean mass on the k selected candidates minus the k/n chance floor > 0.05. C2 [load-bearing] context-differentiated addressing: mean within-context minus mean cross-context target-set Jaccard > 0.05 -- the Moita 2004 contextual-vs-auditory dissociation transposed; deliberately NOT a bare Jaccard, which aliases perfect addressing with a constant degenerate target set (1.0 either way) whereas the gap gives 0 for the degenerate case. C3 [load-bearing] partial-not-wholesale: ON mean end-of-episode slot differentiation >= 0.5x the matched OFF value at the same seed. C4 pe-spike sparsity: fire fraction <= 0.25, pre-registered from normal theory (a >1-SD excursion is ~0.16 of ticks), NOT tuned to the probe's ~0.5. READINESS IS NOT CIRCULAR: the gate asserts the INPUTS (baseline slot differentiation, PE spread, fire count, both contexts represented), strictly upstream of C1, so uniform attribution on a DIFFERENTIATED store is a falsification of the claim rather than a starved criterion. Fire-dependent preconditions are scoped OUT of the gate-shut arm via applies_to/structural_max (the V3-EXQ-785 rule) and do not vacate the live arm. Smoke (1 seed) PASS: all 7 engagement checks green including episode_restore_effective; validate_experiments --strict OK; validate_recording --strict complete.
